messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — service: text-gen, model_variant: redwood-llm-v2-1024
incident-bot: error-rate 5xx increased to 12% (baseline 0.5%), latency p95 jumped to 1.8s. Affected regions: eu-west-1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/INC-2026-132
incident-bot: Paging oncall.

alice: Oncall (alice) here — investigating. Where's the deploy window? Anyone rolled the variant recently?

bob: I rolled a kernel tweak to the runtime yesterday morning but only saw minor perf changes in canary. Checking logs now.

carol: I'm seeing memory growth on nodes running variant redwood-llm-v2-1024, KV cache miss rate up, frequent restarts.

bob: Confirmed. Reproduced locally with load test. Suggest disabling variant and routing traffic to redwood-llm-stable-1 (safer, quantized) while we investigate.

alice: Agreed. Plan: 1) disable redwood-llm-v2-1024 from routing 2) route 100% to redwood-llm-stable-1 3) monitor for errors 4) post update to status page. Any objections?

dave: No objections, I'll update status page + notify affected enterprise customers.

bob: Running disable command now.

bob: ```
# disable specific model variant from routing (temp)
redwoodctl variants disable --model-id redwood-llm-v2-1024 --reason 'elevated 5xx and kv-cache regressions' --until '2026-03-15T04:00:00Z'
```

deploy-bot: Job queued -> job/78321. Running rollout change across eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: Job complete -> job/78321. Variant redwood-llm-v2-1024 marked DISABLED for routing.

alice: Applying routing override to move traffic to redwood-llm-stable-1.

bob: ```
# set routing policy override
redwoodctl routing set-override --selector 'service:text-gen' --route-to redwood-llm-stable-1 --weight 100
```

deploy-bot: Routing override applied (id: rtv-4490).

eve: Running smoke tests against stable variant now.

eve: Smoke tests: generate text, embeddings sample, latency checks — all green :white_check_mark: p95 200ms, no 5xx.

carol: Error rate dropped back to 0.6% within 2 minutes of reroute. Latency normalized. Looks like disabling the variant mitigated it.

dave: Status page updated: "Mitigation in place — traffic routed to stable variant. Engineers investigating root cause." Slack thread linked.

alice: Handoff: I'm going offline for 30m. Carol taking primary. If anything regresses, page again.

carol: Acknowledged. I'll collect heap dumps from affected nodes and compare runtime kernels. Also will trigger a targeted canary to revalidate the variant once we have fixes.

bob: Collected heapdumps -> s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-132/heapdumps/

alice: Reminder to create incident ticket + postmortem in #postmortems. Label: model-variant-rollback, severity: sev2.

dave: Assigned POC for customer comms and follow-up. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem after root cause analysis.

alice: Closing the active mitigation. If no regression in 60m, we'll keep variant disabled until a safe patch/rollback is validated. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT update — mitigation applied. Current status: mitigated. Trigger: auto-notify customers via status page.

carol: Added note to internal runbook: when model variant experiences KV cache regressions, prefer routing to stable quantized variant and disable variant until patched.

bob: Filing follow-up PR to revert kernel tweak and add more runtime telemetry. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/commit/PR-4521

eve: I'm taking over monitoring for the next 2 hours. Paging channel: #incidents.

alice: Thanks all. Good job moving fast.
